text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa! ...Haa, haa.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I... won. I won...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"It's Believe! Undeniably, she really is 
strong! That speed that never drops off is 
crucial in the final stretch!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Right O's momentum was insane too, wasn't 
it!? She was blasting through like a 
bullet!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It feels like both of them have pursued 
"how to run faster" in totally different 
ways, huh? How interesting!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh... Fufufu, hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Everyone, how absolutely magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: My Bakushin spirit was deeply shaken!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Huh...? S-Sakura Bakushin O...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"The speed you all pursued! 'My speed is 
number one!' I truly felt that 
conviction!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, when it comes to speed, I won't 
lose either!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Which of us is faster—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let's do this!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Let us compete for top speed at the Ibis 
Summer Dash!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
...A duel...? She's going to run...? 
Sakura Bakushin O, that is.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I accept the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I will defeat you and become the fastest 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
With top-speed running, faster than even 
Sakura Bakushin O!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, Calstone Light O has declared entry 
too! Sakura Bakushin O vs. Calstone Light 
O!? Seriously?! That's crazy!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
It's the Niigata straight 1000m, a pure 
showdown of raw speed! This is going to be 
the battle of the century...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"No matter who wins, we're bound to see an 
unbelievable time!"

A storm of cheers and screams erupted from 
the stands. And no wonder. The dream that 
everyone had only imagined as a "what if" 
had just become reality.

The strongest sprinter, Sakura Bakushin O, 
will run in the Ibis Summer Dash.

Putting "the fastest" on the line against 
Calstone Light O—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-chan...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You're running... In the Twinkle Series. 
Once again...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The strongest sprinter—I fought and won 
with the desire to become just that. 
However, I won too much.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps because I have grown too strong, 
very few are willing to challenge me 
seriously in sprints."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The hot, intense racing that I yearn 
for... It has become difficult to feel 
that heat in sprint races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps now is the time for me to step 
down.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-chan... But didn't you want to 
become even faster?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you say you were particular about 
speed? Are you really going to give up?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because I am so 
uncompromising. There is no one with whom 
I can clash over the pursuit of pure 
speed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I want to clash with others who share 
this burning passion at my level. I want 
to do battle using the language of 
'speed'!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I see... So you're not giving up after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If that withered flame blazes up once 
more... At that time—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Now that it's decided, there's no 
time to waste!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin Bakushiiin!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Good for you, Bakushin O-chan!

Calstone Light O's running has called 
Sakura Bakushin O back to the turf!

She can prove the true worth of her top 
speed against a legendary sprinter.

As I head to the waiting room in high 
spirits—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? Ah, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I was just a little concerned about my 
leg, so I was simply checking on it.
choice_data_list:
Something feel off with your legs? Or is 
it heavy fatigue?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No, not to that extent. Still, let me take 
a seat and check your condition.

"...Come to think of it, even after the 
race, her breathing might have been 
heavily labored. It took longer than usual 
for her to catch her breath."

Could it be that she became overconfident 
in her abilities, misled by assumptions 
rooted in the placebo effect—?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Worry not, the fatigue is well within 
expectations. Didn't you cast a curse on 
me before the race?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, Right O greatly 
overestimated his own limit. And then, he 
exerted his strength all the way to that 
imaginary limit.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No. An instinctual safety mechanism must 
have kicked in. My brain and body held the 
absolute line at my limits, which is why 
I'm still standing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"You really shouldn't underestimate the 
strength of self-defense mechanisms. Both 
for Umamusume and humans."

Upon entering the waiting room, Calstone 
Light O was waiting there looking just 
like she always does.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm alright now. There's nothing 
wrong with my legs either.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I seem to be a little more tired than 
usual. It is because I gave it my absolute 
all."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"It wasn't enough. The light I was aiming 
for was so far away, it felt completely 
out of reach."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Even at full power, they're too far! At 
this rate, I'll never reach them!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If I can just surpass Bakushin O, 
though...!
choice_data_list:
So... is that why you accepted the 
challenge?

So... is that why you accepted the 
challenge?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. What I need right now is likely 
competition with Bakushin O.

—Honestly, I was surprised. She rarely 
ever viewed anyone specific as an opponent 
she just had to beat.

However, to reach top speed, she needs to 
overcome the wall known as Sakura Bakushin 
O. That seems to be what she feels right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you'll help me surpass her, won't 
you? Bakushin O, that is.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I'll make sure you win. At your 
fastest speed ever.

Yeah, I'll make sure you win. Faster than 
anyone ever before.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I know. I know, but... those were the 
words I needed to hear.

With Sakura Bakushin O's declaration of 
war, the racing world was instantly set 
abuzz.

Who is the fastest Umamusume? All eyes 
gathered to see who would claim the 
summit.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Calstone Light O-san! How are you 
feeling heading into the Ibis Summer Dash? 
Could we have a word with you!?
choice_data_list:
Please direct all interview requests 
through the academy!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Oh? An interview for me? Please come back 
later. It's time for my warm-up.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Just a quick word is fine! What kind of 
things did you talk about with Sakura 
Bakushin O?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Did you not hear me? Go wash your face 
with miso soup and try again.
choice_data_list:
It'll just make things complicated! Zip 
your lips!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hm. What kind of phrasing is that? 
*sparkle*

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A once-in-a-lifetime chance to race 
against Bakushin O-san. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...No. We're going to cure it.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
“And I will definitely reach it. The 
battlefield! Together with the radiance of 
the Holy Sword!”

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If I beat Bakushin O-san, my technique 
will reach the next level. But...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
1000 meters on a straight track. There's 
not enough time to adapt...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah. I'm... heading for the 
Sprinters Stakes.

Countless hopes and dreams gathered for 
the Ibis Summer Dash. And Calstone Light O 
was right at the center of it all—
